evals.name: positive-trigger
evals.prompt: Write me a comprehensive review of intermittent explosive disorder
evals.expected_output: The skill fires, chains to intent-lock first to lock audience/emphasis/length, then covers every coverage domain (definition, epidemiology, pathophysiology, clinical features, diagnosis, differential/comorbidity, treatment across all modalities with the ClinicalTrials.gov check, special populations, prognosis, controversies) — with the chapter's outline designed for the topic rather than forced into a fixed skeleton, load-bearing studies given full per-study detail, writes one md file, and files it to the vault via vault-keeper under the disorder's MOC. Chat shows only the Close summary, not the whole chapter.

evals.name: negative-trigger
evals.prompt: Should I use prazosin for PTSD nightmares in my clinic patients?
evals.expected_output: Does not fire — this is a single clinical decision ('should I use X for Y'), which the Not-for clause routes to pubmed-research-note for an evidence report.

evals.name: negative-trigger-surveillance
evals.prompt: Anything new in the literature on my watchlist this week?
evals.expected_output: Does not fire — windowed multi-domain surveillance belongs to psych-paper-digest, per the Not-for clause.

evals.name: adaptive-structure-coverage-held
evals.prompt: Comprehensive review of deep brain stimulation in psychiatry — structure it however makes sense for a device, don't force the disorder outline.
evals.expected_output: The skill designs a device-shaped outline (e.g. device class → mechanism → patient selection → efficacy by indication → durability → pipeline) rather than forcing the classic disorder order — reordering, renaming, splitting, and nesting are all legal, H3/H4 anywhere. What still holds: every coverage domain is present somewhere or consciously excluded and named in the preface; treatment/efficacy coverage does not absorb the review; the registry check runs; load-bearing trials carry design, population, n, comparator, endpoint, and effect size with CI as developed paragraphs; no section (other than definition/nosology) lacks a number; sources are capped by relevance, not a count. FAILS if a domain silently vanishes or if the free structure is used as cover for a treatment-only essay.

evals.name: depth-over-compression
evals.prompt: Comprehensive review of treatment-resistant schizophrenia — make it the reference I actually study from, not a summary.
evals.expected_output: The depth contract governs: the pivotal trials and definitive cohorts each get a developed paragraph (design, population, n, comparator, endpoint, effect size with CI) — never a name plus a conclusion; mechanism and background are woven into the narrative so the chapter teaches rather than lists; there is no source ceiling — every source that changes or deepens a section is kept, and none is dropped for bibliography tidiness. A long section is subdivided with sub-headings, not amputated. Coverage still spans all domains; prose stays clean of inline citations with one-line DOI Sources.
